figurative_meaning_en: to suppress or keep under control
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার কর্মচারীদের পায়ের তলায় রেখেছে।
রাজনীতিতে প্রতিপক্ষকে পায়ের তলায় রাখতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He keeps his employees under his feet.
In politics, you have to keep the opposition under your feet.
note: This idiom reflects traditional notions of authority and subjugation in Bengali society.
